Set the standard before the first invitation
Build the assessment around the program
Choose role-relevant tasks and time limits with your engineers and our assessment scientists. Apply the same criteria across each program’s markets.
Allow AI or turn it off, and focus the review
Allow the AI Assistant or turn it off for each task, and every prompt and response is saved for review. Identity, behavioral and similarity checks contribute to an integrity risk rating. Reviewers inspect the signals and make the call.
Keep candidates moving through your workflow
Send invitations and receive results through your applicant tracking system. Selected tasks from the Codility Task Library score automatically. Review completion and drop-off, and configure accommodations such as extended time where needed.
Explore Screen for engineering
Use a shared rubric for the live round
For programs with a technical assessment center, Codility Interview gives interviewers a shared coding environment and rubric. The transcript and playback preserve the evidence behind their feedback.
Explore Interview
Learn from this season’s results
Codility’s Professional Services team supports assessment design, pass marks and campaign analysis. Review completion, score distributions and pass rates. Cohort fairness analysis uses demographic data your organization supplies.

Multi-market programs need role-relevant tasks, a documented method and support interpreting results.
Codility pairs practical tasks with assessment scientists who support program design and campaign analysis. Fixed rules score the work, and reviewers see how scores and pass rates are produced.

Planning your next intake
The task set and time limit should match the skills being assessed. Codility works with the program team to manage candidate effort, then uses completion and drop-off data to inform adjustments.
Standard tasks carry documented content validation with subject-matter-expert review. Professional Services can run a local validation study for the customer’s roles. Standard library validation and a local study are separate.
Codility monitors adverse impact at measured cut scores for the populations it measures. Analysis of a customer’s cohort uses demographic data supplied by the customer. Codility does not infer demographics.
Codility provides the technical assessment stage alongside the program’s strengths, behavioral and cognitive assessments. The integration supports invitations and results in the existing workflow.
Yes. Enabled AI interactions remain in the candidate record, and the report shows which AI skills the candidate used, with quotes from their own prompts as proof. Claude Code and Codex run across Screen, Interview and Skills Intelligence. Integrity signals are available for human review whether the assessment allows AI or not.
